summary.headline: ICICI Pru AMC Q2 FY27 operating revenue rose 16.3% YoY to INR1,674 crore, but PAT fell 7.8% QoQ to INR889 crore on lower other income.
summary.overview: Operating revenue grew 16.3% YoY and 7% QoQ to INR1,674 crore, and operating PBT rose 15.7% YoY to INR1,181 crore. PAT of INR889 crore was up 6.1% YoY but down 7.8% QoQ, mainly because other income of INR16.9 crore fell on mark-to-market. Total mutual fund QAAUM reached INR11.61 lakh crore (+14.4% YoY), with equity QAAUM at INR6.59 lakh crore (+16.3% YoY) and 13.7% market share. Management said industry gross flows were steady and the net flow decline came from higher redemptions, and it declared an interim dividend of INR30 per share.

financial_highlights.metric: Gross / net yield (H1 FY27, annualised, company level)

segments.name: Mutual fund
segments.commentary: Total QAAUM INR11.61 lakh crore (+14.4% YoY), 13.3% market share, second-largest AMC. Equity QAAUM INR6.59 lakh crore with 13.7% share; equity-oriented hybrid QAAUM INR2.29 lakh crore with 26.4% share.

segments.name: Alternates
segments.commentary: QAAUM INR80,965 crore. PMS QAAUM INR30,791 crore (+21.4% YoY); AIF QAAUM INR24,260 crore. H1 FY27 PMS and AIF gross yield 1.92%, net yield 0.96%.

segments.name: Advisory
segments.commentary: Assets under advisory yield 0.32% in H1 FY27. Management said advisory AUM, mostly international money, has seen outflows for about 1.5 years.

segments.name: SIF
segments.commentary: QAAUM INR4,948 crore in Q2 FY27 versus INR2,678 crore in Q1 FY27. Four strategies are live; a fifth fund was to launch in the quarter.

guidance_outlook: Full-year ESOP cost guided at INR64-68 crore, charged pro rata to P&L.
Alternates net yield broadly expected in the INR90-95 bps range (management also cited 90-100 bps); no yield guidance for mutual funds.
Opex growth in H1 FY27 described as in line with normal increase; no segment-wise opex split given.
PMS business acquisition from ICICI Securities (about INR3,000 crore AUM) pending regulatory approvals.
No infrastructure fund planned; focus on scaling private credit, real estate (pre-leased office), private equity and early-stage PE.
capex_capacity: PMS business acquisition from ICICI Securities approved by the board; approvals and documentation in progress.
Launched in Q2: Balanced Hybrid Fund, Multi Asset Active FoF, Dynamic Asset Allocation Passive FoF, BSE Insurance ETF and three Life Cycle Funds (2031, 2036, 2041 maturities).
Debt AIF strategy not yet launched; management will explore it at an appropriate time.
Structures set up in GIFT City, Luxembourg and Southeast Asia for international advisory funds.
demand_pricing: Industry QAAUM INR87.49 lakh crore (+13.4% YoY, +5.1% QoQ); industry equity QAAUM INR48.19 lakh crore (+15.3% YoY).
Industry equity net flows INR1.06 lakh crore in Q2, down about 7% QoQ; mid and small caps took 36% of H1 FY27 net equity sales versus 22% in FY26.
Company equity distribution mix: MFD 36.1%, national distributors 15.9%, ICICI Bank 7.5%, other banks 10.6%, direct 29.9%.

Management said industry gross flows were steady; the net flow decline was driven by higher redemptions, particularly in BAF and MAF hybrid funds. Monthly SIPs stable; September SIP at INR32,490 crore industry-wide.
Company systematic transactions (SIP plus STP) moderated to INR4,672 crore in September from INR4,872 crore in June.

qa_highlights.question: Why has ICICI Bank channel AUM not grown while other channels grew?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ICICI Bank is an important channel that it works on equally with all others; the outcome depends on each distributor's strategy. The company's ICICI Bank share of the channel was described as about the same as before.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the flow market-share pressure at large AMCs?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross flows were consistent industry-wide, so the net decline was redemption-driven, and redemptions are linked to AUM rather than gross sales. Redemptions are slightly higher, and money moves between schemes and outside the AMC in ways that cannot be tracked.

qa_highlights.question: Why are mutual fund revenue yields rising?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said yield is an outcome of flow mix, including which schemes gain money, old versus new money, and distribution commission, and it does not target a yield.

qa_highlights.question: What is the strategy toward mid and small caps?
qa_highlights.answer: Small-cap fund is fully open; mid-cap is being opened slowly. Management prefers large caps now and said it will build mid/small-cap positioning over 5 to 7 years, waiting for valuations to correct.

qa_highlights.question: Are SIF investors existing customers, and what are SIF unit economics?
qa_highlights.answer: Management treats SIF as part of mutual funds with a INR10 lakh minimum ticket, and says margins are similar to mutual funds. It uses derivatives defensively and does not allow shorting; the customer mix was not disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Is the AUM for alternates fee-bearing?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, management said reported alternates AUM is fee-bearing (drawn-down) AUM only, since fees start on drawdown; committed but undrawn capital is excluded.

risks_watch: Redemptions elevated amid volatile markets; net flows and market share under pressure.
Other income volatility from mark-to-market, which drove the QoQ PAT decline.
SIP composition shifting toward small and mid caps and STP front-loading affecting SIP and lump-sum mix.
Alternates yield at 90-95 bps net; real estate drawdowns and mix changes may move it.
Advisory AUM outflows for about 1.5 years, dependent on international flows.
PMS acquisition from ICICI Securities pending regulatory approvals.
summary.management_tone: Confident on franchise, flows and alternates growth, but guarded on near-term outlook, flows and yields, which management repeatedly said depend on market direction. It was evasive on channel-level SIP, ICICI Bank channel and yield questions, and dismissive of an analyst's other-income focus.
key_quotes: It is very clearly understood that equity markets and mutual funds are for the long term.
Redemption is related to the AUM that you have.
We do not give guidance on what we expect of the yield. It's actually an outcome.
So, it is a very simple industry. I think SEBI has created a very simple industry.

growth.why: No revenue growth guidance for the year; only ESOP cost (INR64-68 crore) and alternates net yield (INR90-95 bps) were guided, with no mutual fund yield guidance. Q2 operating revenue +16.3% YoY and operating PBT +15.7% YoY are reported, but the brief gives no forward revenue number and the growth is not tied to specific capacity or orders.
